items.title: Separation properties descend through pushouts along closed immersions
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)

items.difficulty_reason: In the chapter's pushout situation (closed immersion Z -> X plus integral Z -> Y with the pushout existing by the main proposition), the lemma proves: if X and Y are separated then the pushout Y coproduct_Z X is separated, and the same holds for separated over S, quasi-separated, and quasi-separated over S. The retained proof is written: the canonical surjection Y coproduct X -> Y coproduct_Z X is universally closed (the pushout construction's effect on the coproduct's diagonal, inherited from the proposition's properness clause), and the universally-closed-descent criterion for separatedness (Morphisms, lemma image-universally-closed-separated: a scheme admitting a surjective universally closed map from a separated scheme is separated) applies; the quasi-separated and relative variants run on the identical rails (the author's Same with clause). Retained author proof at lines 19855-19859.
